gen-dafont-stilu-montserrat: Stilu looks refined and glassy, its tall lowercase bowls swelling like little bulbs. Montserrat follows with geometric, wide-open curves, and Stilu earns its place in big, short lines.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-alpino: Alpino is cozy and casual, with a tall body that makes its ascenders look stubby and its curve endings stay apart. Paragraphs in it feel relaxed and snug, never fussy.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-familjen-grotes: Stocky and bold up top, lively underneath. True North packs a tall middle band into punchy display lines, while Familjen Grotesk, a plain sans, leaves its bowls open on one side for easy running text.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-hoover: True North leads with a tall middle band that makes every line look stocky, and its curves refuse to close. Hoover, the text serif, brings robust refinement.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-nunito: Nunito brings big round lowercase bowls and terminals that finish well clear of the stem, so it feels friendly. And True North, with its stocky tall middle band, gives the heading a bold, contemporary punch above it.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-public-sans: Public Sans carries a hefty lowercase and broad open counters, trustworthy and steady as a plain sans. True North does the loud work up top with its stocky, unclosed curves, while Public Sans handles the quiet reading.
gen-dafont-true-north-fs-ranade: Stocky meets softly shifting. True North's tall middle band and unclosed curves are bold, while Ranade's weight wavers only slightly, like brushed watercolor, with stroke ends set far apart. Its sans text stretches out and moves gently.
gen-dafont-true-north-gf-cascadia-code: True North is stocky and bold, its curves left open. Cascadia Code, a plain sans, spaces its wire-like monoline letters far apart, so reading runs slowly and smoothly around every bend.
gen-dafont-upheaval-fs-karma: Upheaval has a tight, throat-catching feel, with a tall sturdy lowercase and closed letters. But Karma, a classic serif, opens its terminals clear of the stem and its gentle modulation never snags the eye.
gen-dafont-upheaval-fs-merriweather-sans: Upheaval is tight and closed, tall and sturdy. Merriweather Sans gives it a counterweight, with a large lowercase and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right, so the heading and text complement each other.
